  d.haztype::text AS hazard_type,
  d.haz_level,
  d.region_tag,

    (SUM(s.foodtons) * 1000) / (NULLIF((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected')::bigint, 0) * 2),
    SUM(s.water_liters) / (NULLIF((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected')::bigint, 0) * 3)

LEFT JOIN operations o ON b.beneopsref = o.opsregistry
